title: Assessment Questions
pageDescription: Create and manage assessment questions for competency evaluation

statsCards.totalTooltip: The total number of assessment questions in the system, including all difficulty levels and question types.
statsCards.withIndicatorsTooltip: Questions linked to at least one behavioral indicator. Linked questions contribute to competency scoring during assessments.
statsCards.avgTimeLimitTooltip: The average time limit across all timed questions. Questions without a time limit are excluded from this calculation.
statsCards.hardQuestionsTooltip: Questions marked as Advanced or Specialized difficulty. These are used to differentiate high-performing candidates in assessments.
